newsitem.title: INDIA: CRISIL rates Coal India bonds issue A+.
newsitem.headline: CRISIL rates Coal India bonds issue A+.

text.p: The Credit Rating Information Services of India Ltd (CRISIL) said on Tuesday it rated state-owned Coal India Ltd's proposed 4.0 billion-rupee bond issue 'A+'.
"This rating indicates adequate safety with respect of timely payment of interest and principal on the instrument," CRISIL said.

Coal India is a monopoly which accounts for over 90 percent of the coal produced in the country, but the company's performance is affected by high overhead costs and its dependence on government-fixed prices for coal, CRISIL said.
"In the past, these price revisions had fallen short of the desired levels ....(affecting) profitability and strained gearing, covering and liquidity ratios," CRISIL said.
It said recent partial deregulation allowed the firm to charge market prices for 35 percent of its products which would improve its profitability.
